title.narrative: Leadership for Sustainable Development in Georgia Phase II
Ledarskap för hållbar utveckling i Georgien Phase II

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för projektet Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II är att påskynda och skala upp företagens lokala medverkan och engagemang för att uppnå de globala målen för hållbar utveckling genom att stärka ansvarsutkrävande och skapa en bättre miljö för konstruktivt samarbete mellan intressenter.

The overall objective of the project Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.

The overall objective of phase II of the LSDG project is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.
Specific Objective 1: To provide a clear framework and encourage ambitious commitments to corporate sustainability and responsible business practices aligned with the corporate sustainability standards and the SDGs in Georgia.
Specific Objective 2: To support the enhancement of public policy in the field of corporate sustainability and its further implementation in Georgia, through advocacy, dialogue, and collective action around a shared agenda.
Specific Objective 3: To ensure organizational development and sustainability of the UN Global Compact Network Georgia, enabling the organization to effectively promote corporate sustainability and business involvement in the implementation of Agenda 2030 in Georgia.

In 2025, the UN Global Compact Network Georgia (UNGCNG) advanced significantly in expanding its reach, strengthening governance, supporting EU sustainability alignment, and deepening engagement with both local and international partners. The Global Compact team has demonstrated great flexibility and adaptive capacity.
Key Achievements:
Network Growth & Governance: 42 new participants joined total active companies reached 178. Approximately 500 companies engaged through outreach. Three General Assemblies were held, ensuring transparency and accountability. Four new Board members were elected during an extraordinary assembly.
Action Platforms & Accelerators: Five thematic Action Platforms operated throughout the year, plus a new Transformational Governance platform. 22 platform meetings reached 542 participants. Five accelerator programs engaged 64 organizations and 135 representatives.
Events & International Engagement: UNGCNG organized 50 events with 2,100 participants. Actively represented Georgia in major global forums (Leaders Summit, Business & Human Rights Forum, Web Summit, COSP 11). Hosted two high-level international events in New York during UNGA Week.
International Exposure for Georgian Companies: 40 representatives from 20 companies joined international study visits and EU learning groups. Study visits to Sweden, Denmark, and Brussels strengthened understanding of EU sustainability directives and best practices.
Corporate Sustainability Award 2025: Achieved record engagement: 166 applications, confirming strong business interest in sustainability.
EU Corporate Sustainability Alignment: Key initiatives included: EU Sustainability Navigator Platform (88 companies). Certified Academy courses (50 hour and 10 hour programs). Georgian translations of EU aligned sustainability materials. Study visit to EU institutions for direct dialogue with policy bodies.
Regional Research: AI for SDGs UNGCNG launched a flagship regional research project on private sector AI use across Eastern Europe to be published in March 2026.
Corporate Sustainability Academy: Four courses delivered to 80 participants from 50 companies, advancing practical compliance and sustainability skills.
UN System Cooperation: Strong collaboration with UNDP, UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, UN RCO, and World Bank included: Joint Academy programs and learning tools. Contributions to Action Platforms. Participation in juries and events. Media content production and knowledge products.
Media & Communications: 30 TV episodes, 3 magazine issues, 58 articles, and 53 interviews. Corporate Sustainability Award 2025 attracted 167 applications and 112 finalists.
Organizational Development: Investments in staff training, digital tools, and improved infrastructure strengthened operational resilience.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
